fields.ic_name: ARM Serial Wire Debug (SWD) — ADIv5 (ARM IHI 0031C)

channels.name: SWCLK
channels.purpose: Serial Wire Clock. Host-generated free-running clock; SW-DP wire-level FSM advances on each rising edge during a transaction. Target samples SWDIO on rising edges in host-driven phases; target drives SWDIO on falling edges in target-driven phases.

channels.name: SWDIO
channels.direction_tester: output (Request, Data-Write phases); input (ACK, Data-Read phases)
channels.direction_device: input (Request, Data-Write phases); output (ACK, Data-Read phases)
channels.purpose: Serial Wire Data Input/Output. Bidirectional 1-wire data line; direction-controlled by SWD wire-level FSM with explicit 1-bit Turnaround periods.

channels.name: nTRST
channels.purpose: Optional asynchronous TAP reset (active LOW) — present only on SWJ-DP variants that expose the JTAG-side TRST pad. Forces SWJ-DP to TestLogicReset (in JTAG mode) or SW-DP Idle (in SWD mode).

channels.name: SWO
channels.purpose: Serial Wire Output. Optional asynchronous serial trace pin (NOT part of the SWD protocol) — carries ITM / DWT trace packets from the TPIU at a baud rate set by ASYNCCLKDIV. Separate physical pin from SWDIO/SWCLK.
channels.idle_level: TPIU-driven output; idle level depends on the encoding (Manchester or NRZ)

global_signals.name: VDD-IO (per target)
global_signals.purpose: Drives the SWD pins' I/O voltage; per-device datasheet. Auto-sensing debug probes (J-Link, ST-Link V3) match this automatically.

global_signals.name: GND
global_signals.purpose: Common ground reference between host probe and target.

ordering_rules.shift_bit_order: LSB first on SWDIO for all phases (Request, ACK, Data, Parity).
ordering_rules.ack_packet_lsb_order: OK = 100 1 1 (LSB first: 1, 0, 0 = 0x1); WAIT = 0 1 0 (LSB first: 0, 1, 0 = 0x2); FAULT = 0 0 1 (LSB first: 0, 0, 1 = 0x4).
ordering_rules.data_packet_lsb_order: Bit 0 of the 32-bit data first, bit 31 last; parity follows as bit 32.
ordering_rules.swj_dp_selection_lsb_order: Both 0xE79E and 0xE73C shifted LSB first on TMS/SWDIO.

dependency_graph.common_rule: Host drives SWCLK + SWDIO during Request and Data-Write phases; reads SWDIO during ACK and Data-Read phases. SW-DP FSM is driven by SWCLK rising edges + the position within the 46-bit transaction; SWDIO direction-change happens at explicit Turnaround periods.
dependency_graph.data_dependency: Each transaction's data field (read or write) is positioned at bits 12..43 in the 46-bit transaction; the Request packet (bits 0..7) identifies the target register and direction; the ACK (bits 9..11) gates whether the data field is meaningful. Posted reads compose multiple transactions into a pipeline where read N's data appears with read N+1's ACK.

handshake_pairs.name: SWCLK_DRIVE
handshake_pairs.rule: Free-running clock during a transaction; one bit per rising edge in host-driven phases; one drive per falling edge in target-driven phases.

handshake_pairs.name: REQUEST_DRIVE
handshake_pairs.rule: 8-bit Request packet driven on SWDIO during transaction bits 0..7.

handshake_pairs.name: TURNAROUND_A
handshake_pairs.rule: 1-cycle SWDIO direction-change at bit 8 (configurable 1-4 via TRNCNT).

handshake_pairs.name: ACK_DRIVE
handshake_pairs.rule: 3-bit ACK on SWDIO during transaction bits 9..11 (target-driven on falling edges).

handshake_pairs.name: DATA_DRIVE_WRITE
handshake_pairs.rule: 32-bit data + 1-bit parity on SWDIO during bits 12..44 for RnW=0 transactions.

handshake_pairs.name: DATA_DRIVE_READ
handshake_pairs.rule: 32-bit data + 1-bit parity on SWDIO during bits 12..44 for RnW=1 transactions.

handshake_pairs.name: LINE_RESET
handshake_pairs.rule: ≥ 50 consecutive SWCLK cycles with SWDIO=HIGH forces SW-DP to Idle.

handshake_pairs.name: SWJ_DP_MODE_SELECT
handshake_pairs.rule: 16-bit pattern shifted on SWDIO/TMS after line reset switches SWJ-DP between SWD and JTAG modes.
